basic_info.description:
A rare opportunity in Miraloma Park, this bright and private 2BD/2BA two-story townhouse-style condo offers exceptional tranquility with no neighbors above or below. Steps from Mollie Stones and minutes from West Portal, Noe Valley, and Diamond Heights, it blends charm, convenience, and connectivity Ideal for those seeking both serenity and accessibility. Natural light fills the inviting living room, where large windows, a cozy fireplace, and an adjoining dining area create a warm, welcoming space perfect for relaxing or entertaining. The beautiful white kitchen features quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and ample storage, offering both style and functionality. Upstairs, two spacious bedrooms provide peaceful retreats, complemented by two elegantly renovated bathrooms one with a shower-over-tub, the other with a walk-in shower.
Modern laminate flooring throughout adds sophistication, while a private balcony is perfect for enjoying morning coffee or an evening breeze. In-unit laundry and secure parking provide added convenience. A charming courtyard enhances the sense of community, while easy access to shops, cafes, transit, and freeways makes daily life effortless. Offering privacy, modern comfort, and a prime location, this exceptional home is a must-see.
